title: Microglia Isolation Using Magnetic Cell Sorting from Adult Mouse Brains
author: Aisha Sati
materials: Carefully remove supernatant and resuspend in a lysis buffer (RLT, Qiagen, 74004) and storedat -80 °C until processing for qPCR.

steps.title: Initial Tissue Dissection
steps.instruction: Following transcardial perfusion with 0.9% saline, dissect the brain region of interest on an ice-cold petri dish using forceps and place it in cold enzyme digestion mix on ice.

steps.title: Enzymatic Digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate brain tissue samples in enzyme digestion mix in a 37 °C bath for 15 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Agitate tubes every 5 minutes (agitate, do not invert to mix).
Pre-cool the centrifuge to 4 °C during this time.

steps.title: Tissue Dissociation
steps.instruction: Dissociate tissue into a single-cell suspension using three separate flame-polished Pasteur pipets with narrowing openings.

substeps.instruction: Pipet up and down 20 times with each pipet, starting from the largest diameter to the narrowest.
Incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes between each pipet step.
Agitate every 5 minutes during each 15-minute incubation period.

steps.title: Cell Filtration and First Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Filter samples into fresh 15 mL tubes using 70 μm nylon filters.

substeps.instruction: Pre-wet each filter by adding 1 mL of HBSS (with calcium/magnesium) to the middle and dragging it to the side.
Centrifuge at 300 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes with max acceleration and half brake.

steps.title: Initial Cell Resuspension
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cell suspension carefully with 3.1 mL of ice-cold 1X PBS, then transfer to a fresh 15 mL tube.

steps.title: Debris Removal
steps.instruction: Perform debris removal using a density gradient.

substeps.instruction: Add 900 µL of cold Debris Removal Solution and mix well by pipetting 10 times slowly up and down.
Slowly layer 4 mL of 1X PBS on top to create a visible gradient, starting with the tube at a 45° angle and gradually bringing it to a vertical position.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at max speed (at least 3000 x g), 4 °C, with max acceleration and max brake.

steps.title: Secondary Wash and Pellet Recovery
steps.instruction: Isolate the cell layer and wash.

substeps.instruction: Remove the top two layers.
Fill the tube up to 14 mL with ice-cold 1X PBS.
Centrifuge at 1000 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes with max acceleration and max brake.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend pellets with 180 µL MACS buffer and 20 µL CD11b microbeads.
Incubate on ice for 15 minutes.
Add 1 mL of MACS Buffer to samples.
Centrifuge at 300 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Magnetic Column Preparation
steps.instruction: Set up the sorting columns in a tissue culture hood.

substeps.instruction: Place columns tightly in the magnet.
Place '-' tubes (for CD11b negative cells) under the columns.
Top columns with fresh nylon filters using autoclaved forceps.
Pre-wash each column with 3 mL of MACS Buffer through the nylon filter.
Pre-wet each filter by adding 1 mL of HBSS (with calcium/magnesium) to the middle and dragging to the side.

steps.title: CD11b Negative Cell Collection
steps.instruction: Pass the labeled cells through the magnetic column to collect negative cells.

substeps.instruction: Remove samples from centrifuge, aspirate supernatant, and resuspend pellets in 500 µL of MACS Buffer.
Add cell suspension to the nylon filter, then rinse the old 15 mL tube with 2 mL of MACS Buffer and add this to the filter.
Add 3 mL of MACS Buffer to the column.
Once liquid has finished flowing through, remove the '-' tubes and place them on ice.

steps.title: CD11b Positive Cell Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the positive cells from the column.

substeps.instruction: Remove columns from the magnet and place them on top of '+' tubes (for CD11b positive cells).
Using a serological pipet, add 5 mL of MACS Buffer to the top of the column, then quickly plunge the column as hard as possible using the supplied plunger.
Repeat the plunge step for a total volume of 10 mL per column.
Place '+' tubes on ice with the '-' tubes.

steps.title: Final Washing and Recovery
steps.instruction: Wash and concentrate the isolated cells.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge '+' and '-' tubes at 300 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant, removing all bubbles (especially from '+' tubes), leaving a meniscus of liquid to avoid cell loss.
Resuspend pellet in 400 µL of ice-cold 1X PBS.
Transfer 400 µL of resuspension to fresh 1.5 mL centrifuge tubes, rinse the old 15 mL tube with 800 µL of 1X PBS, and add the rinse to the 1.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 300 x g, 4 °C, for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Final Filtration and Buffer Exchange
steps.instruction: Perform final filtration and resuspension in HBSS.

substeps.instruction: Add cell suspension over the pre-wet area on each filter.
Rinse old 15 mL tubes with 2 mL of HBSS (with calcium/magnesium), mix by pipetting up and down, and add over the filter.
Fill the new tubes to 15 mL with HBSS (with calcium/magnesium).
Keep samples on ice as much as possible.
